# Coloured circle icons

Figma: `Coloured circle icons`, node `7840:19951` (page Components, `1:28`).
21 variants - `size[3]` x `colour[7]`.

A glyph on a tinted circular surface. Used for category and section markers.

## Markup

```html
<span class="v27-circle-icon v27-circle-icon--medium v27-circle-icon--green">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><!-- glyph --></svg>
</span>
```

## Classes

| Class | Box | Glyph |
|---|---|---|
| `.v27-circle-icon` | required base | |
| `.v27-circle-icon--small` | 24px | 16px |
| `.v27-circle-icon--medium` | 32px | 20px |
| `.v27-circle-icon--large` | 40px | 24px |

Colours: `--green`, `--grey`, `--blue`, `--pink`, `--purple`, `--orange`, `--red`.

## This component does not follow dark mode

It is the only component in the library whose CSS touches the **primitive** tier, because
it is the only one Figma binds that way: `Green/100` behind a `Green/700` glyph, and so on
for all seven ramps. There is no semantic role for "the green circle" to point at.

Primitives have a single mode, so these circles keep their light-mode colours on a dark
surface. That is what the file specifies - see FINDINGS.md #17.

The dark step is not consistent across ramps either. Green, Blue, Purple and Red use the
700 step; Pink, Orange and Grey use 600. The set exposes no `Pink/700`, `Orange/700` or
`Neutral/700`, so this is deliberate.

## Values

Verified per variant on `7840:19941` (medium Green), `7840:19938` (Pink), `7840:19940`
(Grey) and `7840:19939` (Orange). Padding is `--v27-spacing-xs` (4px). The 35px radius is
off every scale - it is Figma's value for a full circle, and browsers clamp it to one at
all three sizes.
